policy: A runtime alias may only rename a linked canonical symbol when its chid and exact source linkage name are proven. Extraction fails closed on missing linkage, name drift, duplicate chid, duplicate runtime name, or alias collision.

indoor_asset.reason: Canonical RoomItem.createRoomItems promotes Stove11 sub0 to the runtime primary. The SWF linkage is package-qualified while recovered ActionScript and service geometry identify the runtime class by leaf name.
